text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Kikuka Sho, the race
said to
determine the strongest
Umamusume, and
Симболи Рудольф is the
picture of composure.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This is one crown she will not give up.
We step
forward, our sights set higher
than ever.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
